title: ROG: A Multi-Layer Manually Annotated Corpus of Spoken Slovenian
domain: prosody; spontaneous speech; interaction; spoken corpus
manual_annotation_evidence: Paper states multi-layer manual annotation; approximately half of the 10-hour/75,000-word corpus has prosodic units, disfluencies and dialogue acts, systematically aligned and cross-referenced.
lineage_issue: Builds on pre-existing Spoken Slovenian Treebank/GOS 2 recordings; only genuinely new manual annotation layers may enter core and underlying recordings must not be recounted.
public_access: Paper states annotations and half the audio are freely available via repository; repository endpoint still needs file-level enumeration.
license_or_terms: CC-BY reported for released transcriptions/annotations and half audio in paper; verify repository-level terms before redistribution.
next_action: Locate public repository; enumerate every annotation/audio file; identify prosodic-unit/disfluency/dialogue layers; verify which layers are human-created vs inherited; ingest only isolatable new manual production-relevant annotations.
notes: High-value recent discovery because prosodic-unit annotation is explicitly manual, but source uses legacy recordings. No core promotion until layer-level lineage is verified.
